result.topic_en: The page finishes a remark on obtaining all solutions of a differential equation by eliminating a parameter c via df/dc = 0, and then states Klein's fundamental theorem on constructing rational functions of the variables of an isomorphic group that transform like given variables under a group of linear transformations.
